name: ComfyMathExpression (simpleeval)
plain: Core scalar expression node. It runs user text through the simpleeval library with a fixed function table, against named numeric inputs a..z, and returns float, int and bool. Not Python eval; pow is wrapped with an exponent cap. Tensors are not accepted.
math:
result = simple_eval(expression, names=inputs + values, functions={sum,min,max,abs,round,pow(cap 4000),sqrt,ceil,floor,log,log2,log10,sin,cos,tan,int,float})
rejects non-numeric and non-finite results

claims.text: Uses simpleeval, not eval(); safer than the many eval-based pack nodes, though no sandbox has been tested here.
